title: colorcube
summary: Return the colorcube colormap as an m-by-3 RGB array.
description: `colorcube` returns a colorcube palette as an m-by-3 numeric RGB array with values in [0, 1]. With no argument, it uses the current colormap length, or 256 when no figure colormap length is active.
behaviors: `colorcube(m)` returns exactly `m` rows, where `m` must be a nonnegative integer.
`m` can use any of the eight integer classes. It is read exactly as a host structural row count, and the result remains an m-by-3 double matrix.
Resident scalar controls are rejected without provider dispatch; `colorcube` does not run a numeric GPU kernel.
The result can be passed directly to `colormap`.

faqs.question: What size is `colorcube()`?
faqs.answer: It returns the active colormap length when one exists, otherwise 256 rows by 3 columns.

faqs.question: Which integer classes can specify `m`?
faqs.answer: All eight built-in integer classes are documented: `int8`, `int16`, `int32`, `int64`, `uint8`, `uint16`, `uint32`, and `uint64`. The value must be nonnegative and no larger than RunMat's allocation guard.

gpu_residency: The generated colormap is a host double matrix. A resident `m` control is rejected without gathering.
gpu_behavior: `colorcube` performs host structural allocation and RGB generation only; it does not invoke provider kernels.
